coarse.purpose: heuristic only, all mirrors at 12 selected times; no rating or deterministic impossibility

selection: Two new candidates, both full60 if startup budget estimate permits; highest q among estimated P>=60000, otherwise highest P for diagnostic holdout. Point ranking does not prove improvement beyond numerical resolution.
deterministic_elimination: only explicit geometry/model-domain failure; optical low scores remain heuristic exclusions
random_pairing: CRN keyed by position_key and standard60 time index and batch; same normalized coordinates/directions for shared keys, not necessarily same physical mirror; different namespaces independent

confirmation.U: max(t7 whole-batch jackknife halfwidth, final-half-prefix difference, final-raw-integral difference) + coordinatewise full-range low-survivor(<100) influence bound
confirmation.rating: annual P - U_P >=60000kW and all report metrics pass and no required unresolved state
confirmation.sample_zero_rule: no silent zero/one; pooled zeros or unknown are unresolved absent validated independent certificate; no seed retries
confirmation.interval: pointwise approximate t7 diagnostic only; U is numerical work indicator, not strict confidence bound or physical uncertainty

search_limits.tower: center(0,0) only for this bounded followup; combined with initial12 already evaluated nonzero tower positions
search_limits.dimensions: C21 width=height6,z6,phi0; C22 width=height6.5,z6,phi=pi/6; both tower(0,0). Two bounded joint structural comparisons.
search_limits.layout: common hexagonal shells indexed k, six sectors s and integer edge slot j; all share d=w+5+.05 and angle phi; center clipping; squared distance d^2(a^2+ab+b^2)>=d^2; not the old circle generator

budget.stop_rule: per-time/object checkpoint guards; initial coarse preserves initial fine and freeze estimates; skip new stage if extrapolated cost plus freeze estimate exceeds remaining search allocation; estimates are not deterministic runtime bounds
budget.followup_fine_prediction: last observed fine evaluation seconds times1.1 times mirror-count ratio; startup estimate, not hard guarantee

extension_basis: Circular-ring initial search produced no estimated feasible full60 design; add explicitly new Q2-A six-sector straight-edge shells with common triangular lattice, no pointwise binary selection, same physical model/constraints.
pre_score_stagger_check: for each stagger design before any score: max candidate-count object at12/9 and6/15, allN potential obstacles, identical64 rays screened vs exhaustive; all seven event arrays plus g
freeze_if_rating_unmet: After bounded followup, freeze highest full60 P if no estimated feasible candidate; confirmation is diagnostic and cannot imply power met.
